voice.name: Open Sector - Engineer
voice.description: Middle-aged male combat engineer in his late forties, gravelly but good-natured, a slow practical drawl like a seasoned bridge-builder, unflappable and dryly sarcastic, sounds like he would rather be fixing something than fighting, speaks with a pencil behind his ear and a hammer in hand.
voice.sample: Engineer here. Give me a shovel and ten minutes and I'll have you a wall the enemy can cry about. Measure twice, cut once, and keep your heads down while I work.

move.prompt: Soldier jogging on dirt with heavy toolbox and tools clanking on his belt, short burst of footsteps, close, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Field repair work: hammer striking metal a few times, wrench ratchet, short welding torch hiss and sparks, close, outdoors, no music, no voice
